design.scanner: Reuse authoritative ScanTransactionWire. Shared zero-copy structural scan; native existing scanner fully decodes into temporary mutable transaction, preserving native version7 grammar without introducing a parser.
design.complexity: Shared scanner O(inputs + outputs + CompactSize fields); skips script payload by checked offsets. Parallel construction/hash touches O(serialized bytes). Native scanner remains O(serialized bytes + decoded extension fields), including allocations; no native performance claim. O(transaction count) framing/results/error slots bounded at4096.
design.trailing_bytes: Preserve existing acceptance and unread trailing bytes.
design.ordering: Write result i only to slot i; store per-index exceptions and rethrow lowest index after joining.
design.admission: Request eligibility, retained-body64MiB reservation, admission and validation unchanged; context-free PrecomputeSingleTxData warms transaction-owned hash cache only.
design.tests: Differential serial/parallel exact accepted results for threshold counts/max4096, null transaction, repeated and ordered bodies; all valid-payload truncations including multi-byte script length; noncanonical/truncated/oversize nested CompactSize; trailing bytes and overlimit response counts. Differential tests now compare ios_base::failure category. Handler tests check malformed_messages +1, shorttx_received/unsolicited/rate_limited unchanged, no disconnect/escaped exception, no mempool/scoped-state admission for late truncation and oversized count.
design.error_semantics: Malformed framing raises ios_base::failure from the authoritative scanner in original transaction order. Per-slot worker failures rethrow lowest-index exception after all workers finish. Handler catches std::exception unchanged, applies the same rate limiter and malformed metric, then returns without propagation into misbehavior handling. Intentional early rejection: over4096 count raises ios_base::failure before body decode instead of original decode-then-handler bound; same malformed stats and no admission. A different failed-stream cursor is unobservable because handler returns; successful trailing cursor exactly preserved.
